summary: Phase 0 routing/API remediation verification executed on external preview and isolated backend harness. All passed in browser automation. Re-run only after Jest react-router-dom resolution is fixed to make durable frontend unit/router regression green.
rca of the issue: RCA (frontend test infra): router regression test imports App/AppContent, but Jest runtime (craco+react-scripts) cannot resolve `react-router-dom` module despite app build/runtime working. Reproduction: run `cd /app/frontend && yarn test --watchAll=false` with `src/App.routing.test.js` present -> immediate module resolution error before test execution. Mitigation: align Jest resolver/transpile config with installed react-router-dom package format/version or pin compatible test runtime strategy; browser verification currently provides functional coverage until fixed. API/routing product behavior itself was not reproduced as broken in live browser checks.
